g.text: Ring buffer: writing past the final slot wraps to zero
head is the next read; tail is the next write. Physical slots never shift.
1. After dequeue() returns 10: next write is index 3
4. Dequeue 20, 30, 40, 50: head wraps back to 1. Empty.
Full and empty can share head = tail = 1. Compare size with capacity to distinguish them.
In the FULL state: logical position i maps to physical slot (head + i) % 4.
